source.name: d&b audiotechnik V8 product page
source.notes: Retrieved 2026-11-08. Published: 67 Hz-18 kHz (-5 dB), SPLmax 142 dB, 80 degree horizontal (>= 250 Hz), splay 0-14 degrees, up to 24 cabinets, 310x700x460 mm, 34 kg. The 10 degree vertical coverage and its 1 kHz control frequency are assumptions, not published figures. Polar shape is modelled from the nominal coverage (widening below the control frequency); it is not measured data. Rigging and safety calculations must be done in d&b ArrayCalc.
